design_philosophy: A clean, modern, and friendly mobile-first health app. Replacing clinical interfaces with warm, encouraging 'bubbly' aesthetics while prioritizing clarity for daily macro tracking.

spacing_and_layout.general: Mobile-first approach. App container should be max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen bg-background relative shadow-2xl sm:rounded-[3rem] sm:border-[8px] sm:border-slate-800 sm:my-8 sm:overflow-hidden.
spacing_and_layout.padding: p-4 to p-6 for screen edges. Nested elements use p-3 to p-4.
spacing_and_layout.radii: Generous border-radius. rounded-3xl for main cards, rounded-2xl for inner blocks, rounded-full for buttons.
spacing_and_layout.shadows: Soft ambient shadows: shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)] for cards.

bottom_navigation.style: Fixed bottom, z-50 w-full max-w-md mx-auto bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-xl flex justify-around items-center py-4 rounded-t-3xl border-t border-slate-100
bottom_navigation.active_state: Primary color icon with small dot indicator or subtle background pill

dashboard.header: Welcome message with date, streak, and profile avatar. Flex-row, items-center.
dashboard.macro_bento: Large central radial progress for calories. Three smaller vertical bars or mini-rings for Protein, Carbs, Fat underneath or alongside.
dashboard.cards: Solid white backgrounds. Use subtle 1px border-slate-100 to prevent muddiness.

camera_scanner.layout: Full-screen fixed layout (h-full w-full bg-black z-50 relative).
camera_scanner.viewfinder: Central rounded rectangle cutout with scanning animation (a moving horizontal line or corner brackets).
camera_scanner.overlay: Bottom sheet (rounded-t-3xl bg-white p-6 absolute bottom-0 w-full shadow-[0_-10px_40px_rgba(0,0,0,0.1)]) that slides up when an item is detected.
camera_scanner.mode_switch: Pill-shaped toggle floating at the bottom above the sheet to switch between 'Barcode' and 'AI Food Scan'.

buttons.primary: bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-full py-4 px-6 font-bold text-lg hover:bg-blue-700 transition-colors shadow-lg active:scale-95

motion_and_interaction.hover: Subtle scale up (scale-105) for interactive icons, active:scale-95 for buttons.

testing_attributes.rule: ALL interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute.
